## Declarations and implementations

```plato
//==
// # Implicit SDF
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Bounded SDF evaluation, packaging, culling, and CSG
//  - Placed SDF evaluation
//  - Gradients and surface normals
//  - Ray marching
//  - SDF modifier application
//  - Distance operators
//  - Dimensional lifts and symmetry
//  - Signed distance primitives
//  - Sampled signed distance field evaluation
//  - SDF combination tree evaluation

library ImplicitSdf
{
    //=
    // # Bounded SDF evaluation, packaging, culling, and CSG
    //
    // Bodies for `BoundedSdf2D/3D` (`implicit-sdf.types.plato`) and culling
    // helpers over every `BoundedSignedDistanceField*`. Bounds are conservative
    // hints: Eval always delegates to the inner field; MayIntersect /
    // IsCulledBy / MayContainPoint use Bounds only. Distance fidelity — exact,
    // a lower bound, or not a bound (`implicit-sdf.concepts.plato`) — is
    // therefore the inner field's, and each CSG wrapper below inherits the
    // fidelity of the matching `FunctionSdf*` operator in
    // `fields-implicits.library.plato`; only Bounds are propagated here.

    //==
    // # Evaluation and packaging

    // The inner planar distance function at the point. Bounds are ignored.
    Eval(self: BoundedSdf2D, point: Point2D): Number
        => self.Sdf.Eval(point);

    // The inner spatial distance function at the point. Bounds are ignored.
    Eval(self: BoundedSdf3D, point: Point3D): Number
        => self.Sdf.Eval(point);

    // Package a planar function SDF with conservative domain bounds.
    WithBounds(self: FunctionSdf2D, bounds: Bounds2D): BoundedSdf2D
        => (self, bounds);

    // Package a spatial function SDF with conservative domain bounds.
    WithBounds(self: FunctionSdf3D, bounds: Bounds3D): BoundedSdf3D
        => (self, bounds);

    // Any planar SDF as a bounded function SDF with the given domain hint.
    WithBounds(self: ISignedDistanceField2D, bounds: Bounds2D): BoundedSdf2D
        => self.FunctionSdf2D.WithBounds(bounds);

    // Any spatial SDF as a bounded function SDF with the given domain hint.
    WithBounds(self: ISignedDistanceField3D, bounds: Bounds3D): BoundedSdf3D
        => self.FunctionSdf3D.WithBounds(bounds);

    // The stored planar distance function. Implicit, and faithful as an SDF: Eval
    // ignores Bounds entirely, so both values are the same distance function. The
    // bounds are a caller-supplied conservative hint about where sampling is
    // worthwhile, not part of what the field means, and any valid bounds would do
    // (Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Conversions). This overload exists to
    // return the stored field directly rather than re-wrap it in a closure.
    FunctionSdf2D(self: BoundedSdf2D): FunctionSdf2D
        => self.Sdf;

    // The stored spatial distance function. Implicit, for the same reason.
    FunctionSdf3D(self: BoundedSdf3D): FunctionSdf3D
        => self.Sdf;

    //==
    // # Culling (interface surface — SampledSdf and BoundedSdf)

    // True when the two conservative domains overlap (touching counts). A
    // false result means the solids cannot intersect if each Bounds encloses
    // its non-positive region.
    MayIntersect(a: IBoundedSignedDistanceField2D, b: IBoundedSignedDistanceField2D): Boolean
        => a.Bounds.Overlaps(b.Bounds);

    // True when the two conservative domains overlap (touching counts).
    MayIntersect(a: IBoundedSignedDistanceField3D, b: IBoundedSignedDistanceField3D): Boolean
        => a.Bounds.Overlaps(b.Bounds);

    // True when this field's domain overlaps the query rectangle — the query
    // is not entirely outside, so evaluation may still matter.
    MayIntersect(self: IBoundedSignedDistanceField2D, query: Bounds2D): Boolean
        => self.Bounds.Overlaps(query);

    // True when this field's domain overlaps the query box.
    MayIntersect(self: IBoundedSignedDistanceField3D, query: Bounds3D): Boolean
        => self.Bounds.Overlaps(query);

    // True when the query rectangle lies entirely outside this field's
    // conservative domain: safe to skip for solid queries under the enclosure
    // invariant.
    IsCulledBy(self: IBoundedSignedDistanceField2D, query: Bounds2D): Boolean
        => self.MayIntersect(query).Not;

    // True when the query box lies entirely outside this field's domain.
    IsCulledBy(self: IBoundedSignedDistanceField3D, query: Bounds3D): Boolean
        => self.MayIntersect(query).Not;

    // True when the point lies inside the conservative domain. False means the
    // point cannot be inside the solid if Bounds enclose every non-positive
    // distance; true is inconclusive.
    MayContainPoint(self: IBoundedSignedDistanceField2D, point: Point2D): Boolean
        => self.Bounds.Contains(point);

    // True when the point lies inside the conservative domain.
    MayContainPoint(self: IBoundedSignedDistanceField3D, point: Point3D): Boolean
        => self.Bounds.Contains(point);

    //==
    // # CSG with bound propagation (function wrappers only)

    // Pointwise minimum distance; bounds are the union of the operands.
    Union(a: BoundedSdf2D, b: BoundedSdf2D): BoundedSdf2D
        => (a.Sdf.Union(b.Sdf), UnionOfBounds(a.Bounds, b.Bounds));

    // Pointwise minimum distance; bounds are the union of the operands.
    Union(a: BoundedSdf3D, b: BoundedSdf3D): BoundedSdf3D
        => (a.Sdf.Union(b.Sdf), UnionOfBounds(a.Bounds, b.Bounds));

    // Pointwise maximum distance; bounds are the intersection of the operands
    // (may be empty).
    Intersection(a: BoundedSdf2D, b: BoundedSdf2D): BoundedSdf2D
        => (a.Sdf.Intersection(b.Sdf), IntersectionOfBounds(a.Bounds, b.Bounds));

    // Pointwise maximum distance; bounds are the intersection of the operands.
    Intersection(a: BoundedSdf3D, b: BoundedSdf3D): BoundedSdf3D
        => (a.Sdf.Intersection(b.Sdf), IntersectionOfBounds(a.Bounds, b.Bounds));

    // First shape with the second carved out. Bounds stay those of `a`
    // (difference only shrinks the solid).
    Difference(a: BoundedSdf2D, b: BoundedSdf2D): BoundedSdf2D
        => (a.Sdf.Difference(b.Sdf), a.Bounds);

    // First shape with the second carved out. Bounds stay those of `a`.
    Difference(a: BoundedSdf3D, b: BoundedSdf3D): BoundedSdf3D
        => (a.Sdf.Difference(b.Sdf), a.Bounds);

    // Offset surface: distance shifted by amount. Bounds grow by Abs(amount)
    // so a positive offset (larger solid) stays enclosed; a negative offset
    // keeps a conservative (possibly loose) domain.
    Offset(self: BoundedSdf2D, amount: Number): BoundedSdf2D
        => (self.Sdf.Offset(amount), GrowBounds(self.Bounds, amount.Abs));

    // Offset surface with bounds grown by Abs(amount).
    Offset(self: BoundedSdf3D, amount: Number): BoundedSdf3D
        => (self.Sdf.Offset(amount), GrowBounds(self.Bounds, amount.Abs));

    // Inside exactly one of the two shapes; bounds are the union of the operands,
    // since the symmetric difference cannot reach outside either.
    ExclusiveOr(a: BoundedSdf2D, b: BoundedSdf2D): BoundedSdf2D
        => (a.Sdf.ExclusiveOr(b.Sdf), UnionOfBounds(a.Bounds, b.Bounds));

    // Inside exactly one of the two shapes; bounds are the union of the operands.
    ExclusiveOr(a: BoundedSdf3D, b: BoundedSdf3D): BoundedSdf3D
        => (a.Sdf.ExclusiveOr(b.Sdf), UnionOfBounds(a.Bounds, b.Bounds));
```
